versions.short: The resolution designates June 15, 2026, as World Elder Abuse Awareness Day and the month of June 2026 as Elder Abuse Awareness Month. It recognizes the work of judges, lawyers, social workers, law enforcement, health care providers, advocates, and other professionals who help raise awareness of elder abuse. It also honors the Elder Justice Coordinating Council and adult protective services staff who assist victims and investigate reports, and it supports state long-term care ombudsman programs that help prevent abuse and neglect in nursing homes and other care facilities. The resolution praises the Elder Justice Coalition for its public education efforts. Finally, it encourages the public, professionals, and government agencies at all levels to work together to recognize, report, and prevent abuse of vulnerable older adults.
